headline: GOLD $4,554 AND SILVER $73.96 — Precious Metals 20% Off January Peak as Middle East Conflict Enters Week 10
snippet: Gold has retreated roughly 20% from its January high near $5,600/oz as escalating Middle East tensions fuel inflation fears and rate-hike speculation, while silver at $73.96 remains up 150%+ year-over-year. Analysts maintain long-term targets above $5,000 gold; the current dip is drawing comparisons to previous mid-cycle corrections.

headline: COPPER BOUNCES to $5.94/lb — China Curbs Sulfuric Acid Exports Starting May, Threatening Chile's Refining Capacity
snippet: Copper recovered to $5.94/lb on May 5 after sliding to three-week lows on US-Iran market jitters. A structural complication emerged: Beijing is halting sulfuric acid exports to protect domestic supply — a critical input for nearly half of Chile's copper refining capacity — adding a supply-side threat that could outlast the current geopolitical noise.

headline: MONSTER HIT: Power Metallic Drills 17.45m at 9.47% CuEq at Lion Zone — Mineral Resource Estimate on Deck
snippet: Power Metallic Mines (TSX-V: PNPN) reported winter drill results at its Nisk Project Lion Zone: hole 26-094 hit 17.45m at 9.47% CuEq including 6.3m at 17.91%, while hole 26-101 returned 39m at 5.66% CuEq 100m to the east. Infill drilling covering 200m of strike is now complete ahead of a 2026 mineral resource estimate.

headline: K2 GOLD STAKES 21,887 Ha Wolf Project in Yukon — District-Scale Land Play 80km From 3Moz Coffee Gold Deposit
snippet: K2 Gold (TSX-V: KTO) staked the 21,887 ha Wolf Project in west-central Yukon, 80km south of Fuerte Metals' 3Moz Coffee Gold deposit. The Wolf South block hosts a 10km+ gold-in-soil anomaly previously held by Teck Resources — now consolidated into a single land position for the first time. A 2026 LiDAR and soil program is planned.

headline: PUMA DOUBLES Its Jacquet River Land — 8,474 Ha Staked to Lock Up 17km of Regional Structure in New Brunswick
snippet: Puma Exploration (TSX-V: PUMA) staked 8,474 additional hectares at its Jacquet River Project in Northern New Brunswick, more than doubling the land position to secure approximately 17km of major regional structures. A high-resolution drone magnetic and LiDAR survey has been launched to refine drill targets.

headline: WEST SCRAMBLES to Break Russian Uranium Chokehold — Moscow Still Controls 44% of Global Enrichment Capacity
snippet: Russia retains approximately 44% of global uranium enrichment capacity and 20% of conversion — a dependency the West is racing to fix. The Northern Miner maps the new enrichment projects underway as Denison Mines begins construction at the Phoenix ISR project in Saskatchewan and the DOE commits $2.7 billion to domestic enrichment expansion.

headline: HOW USA RARE EARTH ROCKETED 72% IN APRIL: The $2.8B Serra Verde Deal That's Betting Against China's Supply Chain
snippet: USA Rare Earth's (Nasdaq: USAR) April surge followed its $2.8 billion acquisition of Brazilian miner Serra Verde, designed to build a China-independent supply of heavy rare earths including dysprosium and terbium. The Motley Fool unpacks the deal's strategic logic alongside USAR's 12.5% stake in Carester SAS, giving it rare earth separation technology outside Asian supply chains.

headline: AFRICA VS. CANADA VS. AUSTRALIA: Who Is Actually Winning the 2026 Junior Mining Exploration Race?
snippet: African Mining Online compares exploration spending, discovery rates, and permitting timelines across three dominant junior mining jurisdictions, examining whether Africa's lower cost-per-metre advantage is being eroded by sovereign risk — and whether Canada's 2026 staking frenzy signals renewed institutional confidence in the north.

headline: NGEx HITS 48m at 7.72% CuEq at Argentina's Lunahuasi — BRAND NEW Zone Discovered 300m East of Mars
snippet: NGEx Minerals (TSX: NGEX) closed out its Phase 4 program at Lunahuasi with a lateral discovery: a new high-grade zone 300m east of the Mars area with 23m at 4.72% CuEq starting at only 188m depth. Mars itself returned 34m at 7.25% and 48m at 7.72% CuEq — 180m apart — confirming system-wide continuity and open-ended eastward extent.

headline: RECORD $193 BILLION: WGC Q1 2026 Shows Central Banks Hoarding 244t While Asian Investors Pile Into Physical Gold
snippet: The World Gold Council's Q1 2026 Demand Trends report put quarterly gold demand value at a record US$193 billion — a 74% jump year-over-year driven by price, not volume. Central banks net-bought 244 tonnes, Asian bar and coin investment surged 42%, and jewellery volumes fell 23% as retail buyers hit price resistance at record levels.

headline: ZIJIN'S C$5.5B Allied Gold Takeover Nears May 29 Deadline — Canadian National Security Review Cleared
snippet: Allied Gold's C$44/share arrangement with Zijin Gold International — valued at C$5.5 billion and backed by 99.5% of shareholders — cleared Canada's national security review but awaits net benefit determination ahead of a May 29 outside closing date. The deal adds three large African open-pit gold mines in Mali, Côte d'Ivoire, and Ethiopia to Zijin's global portfolio.
